item.title: Passengers planning to travel to US advised to check with airlines
item.description: Passengers planning on travelling to the US are being advised to check with their airline, due to wintry weather conditions today. The east coast of the states has been battered with snow affecting flights from Dublin. DAA cancelled a flight yesterday to New York, and heavy snow is expected into the early hours of this morning. Eoghan Corry, Travel Extra Editor says JFK airport was the worst affected airport yesterday. Advertisement

item.title: Contractor for €7 million overhaul of Connolly Barracks to be appointed in March
item.description: A contractor for the seven-million-euro overhaul of Connolly Barracks in Longford will be appointed in March. It will go to tender on January 12th and the project is due to be finished in October 2027. The former barracks closed in 2009 and it was bought by Longford County Council three years later. Project manager Paul Newell says it'll become a cultural and community hub: Advertisement

item.title: Gardaí say road safety will continue to be a priority after Christmas appeal ends
item.description: An Garda Síochána say road safety will continue to be a priority after the Christmas Road Safety Appeal ends. The current campaign in conjunction with the RSA finishes on January 5th. Roads policing units across the region have been carrying out extra checkpoints this festive season. 174 people died on Irish roads in 2024 and this year's figure has already surpassed that. Sergeant Stephen McDonagh says the target remains the same for members: Advertisement

item.description: Local shoppers are being advised to check their consumer rights this Christmas and New Year. item.title: Popular Roscommon tourist site looks forward to another busy year
item.description: A popular Roscommon tourist site is looking forward to another busy year in 2026. The Arigna Mining Experience in the north of the county ran a very successful Santa's Grotto experience before Christmas. High visitor numbers are expected at the unique experience again this year with coaches arriving from early spring. item.title: Arsenal retain Premier league top spot
item.description: Arsenal maintained their two point advantage at the top of the Premier League with a hard fought 2-1 win over Brighton. Manchester City kept the pressure on the leaders with their 2-1 success at Nottingham Forest. The late Diogo Jota's children led his two former teams out before Liverpool beat bottom club Wolves 2-1 at Anfield.
